description: Seeded Criterion mean baselines for the hard-ish C08 perf gate. Values are nanoseconds (Criterion point estimates). Seeded from draft SLO budgets in docs/ops/SLO.md so CI stays non-flaky; refresh via scripts/seed-bench-baseline.py after a clean cargo bench on ubuntu-latest.

config_toml_from_str.notes: Seeded at SLO p95 budget (1 ms); gate fails above mean_ns * (1 + max_regression).

pool_new_and_list_empty.notes: Seeded at SLO p95 budget (50 ms).

prometheus_render_32.notes: Seeded at SLO p95 budget (500 µs).
